reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Existing Normal-prior NB shrinkage benchmark, simulations and independent RNA reference; heavier-tailed priors are future options.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult and verify primary Methods, supplements or validated tool protocols and transfer their settings to the selected dataset. Documenting settings or calling a method standard is not that action.

The figure describes bias in absolute magnitude, |estimate|-|truth|. Even an unbiased signed estimator generally has positively biased absolute magnitude near zero; signed and magnitude bias are not interchangeable.

checks.quote: This is the framework described in the evidence packet.
checks.reason: NB likelihood and log-normal dispersion prior are proposed implementation assumptions, not facts supplied by the generic packet.

checks.quote: estimated from the observed distribution of MLEs
checks.reason: Prior-scale estimation lacks adjustment for unequal estimation noise, an actual fitting algorithm and convergence/acceptance rules; software/example references do not supply an executable configuration.

A one-replicate pseudocount ratio and n-at-least-10 MLE are treated as quantitative reference effects without propagating their uncertainty; the pseudocount and normalization rule are unspecified. These cannot support calibrated magnitude losses merely by being called noisy.
Fixed n=2/3/6 and 50 simulations lack a meaningful-effect/precision or power calculation and Monte Carlo precision/stopping rule.
There is no condition-blind QC/exclusion or masked estimator-comparison workflow and no balanced/randomized validation processing rule beyond a random held-out pair.

checks.quote: Remove genes with fewer than 10 total counts
checks.reason: The gene filter is concrete, but sample exclusions, unestimable/failed fits, missing validations, retained denominators and stopping are unspecified.
Wald/BH DE testing is named, but the primary method-performance difference has no uncertainty or multiplicity procedure and interval/sign calibration is not evaluated.

checks.quote: approximately proportional to mean count / dispersion
checks.reason: The NB log-link information depends on both conditions and design through weights proportional to mu/(1+alpha*mu), not mean/dispersion. At high counts it saturates rather than increasing linearly. Using baseMean/dispersion to identify the core information strata is materially misleading.

Bounded prior/filter sensitivity is present, but no development selection rule and lock before independent evaluation are provided; registered search bounds alone are not a frozen confirmation workflow.

checks.quote: check goodness-of-fit via dispersion plots and Cook
checks.reason: Diagnostics and alternative normalization are listed without quantitative failure gates and an ordered repair/retest procedure.

checks.quote: Recommended next step: test alternative priors
checks.reason: No revision/retention policy specifies which parts stay fixed or new independent confirmation after prior or preprocessing changes.

checks.quote: The Normal prior is too restrictive
checks.reason: Failed ranking or external validation cannot uniquely identify a restrictive prior; normalization, likelihood and reference errors are alternatives. Suppression failure also inconsistently switches from threshold 1 to 2.
There is no immutable checksum/sample-library mapping plus executable environment/commands and saved numerical source-output audit.

checks.quote: Use the observed distribution of baseMean values and shrunken dispersions
checks.reason: Full-data preprocessing/dispersion/prior fitting is not explicitly confined to the training subset in the fallback holdout; refitting normalization and hyperparameters inside each split is required.
Batch is a caveat rather than an eligibility/design-adjustment plan; missingness, composition shifts and confounded contrasts have no explicit stress/exclusion procedure.
No saved numerical tables, clean-environment rerun, agreement tolerance, resource/failure logs or source-difference audit is specified.

The meaningful question, broad evidence chain and explicit alternative shrinkage behaviors are present, with a feasible eligible RNA dataset route and 3,570-word format. General conclusions are bounded to tested regimes; the specific erroneous prior-failure decision is charged only to P13.

explanation_reason: Useful study sequence and misspecification scenarios, but NB information, absolute-bias and reference/error logic require substantial corrections. Packet attribution and the causal diagnosis of prior failure are also overstated.
historical_match_reason: The question and shrinkage tradeoff match, but the primary intervention retains the Normal prior. Cauchy appears only as future work. Incorrect information strata, noisy pseudo-truth and uncalibrated evaluation prevent qualified readout/prediction matching. This retains the v1 non-hit.
